description: This file defines financial indicator functions (EMA, RSI, MACD) for time series data analysis, primarily used in trading or financial analysis. It provides functions to compute and add these indicators to dataframes.

methods.name: pd.Series ema(series: pd.Series, span: int)
methods.description: Calculates the exponential moving average of a pandas Series.

methods.name: pd.Series rsi(series: pd.Series, period: int = 14)
methods.description: Calculates the Relative Strength Index for a pandas Series.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame macd(series: pd.Series, fast: int = 12, slow: int = 26, signal: int = 9)
methods.description: Computes the Moving Average Convergence Divergence indicator, returning a DataFrame with MACD line, signal, and histogram.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame add_indicators(df: pd.DataFrame, indicator_names: list[str])
methods.description: Adds specified indicators (RSI, EMA, MACD) to a DataFrame based on closing prices.
